responsibility: Defines the AVR backend’s machine-description predicates that classify RTL operands beyond what generic predicates provide. These predicates recognize AVR-specific register subsets, I/O-space addresses, flash and MEMX memory references, constrained constants, pseudo-only forms used to keep combiner/reload safe, comparison operator groups, and other target-specific operand properties that `avr.md` and companion `.md` files rely on for correct pattern matching and splitting.
